sampling: Python random.Random; fixed stratum order lab-with-abstract, lab-title-only, external-with-abstract, external-title-only; pools sorted by paper id; sample then shuffle
abstract_availability_rule: Current all-papers-with-abstracts abstract is nonempty and quality is existing_abstract_not_individually_reverified or source_abstract_verified_title_and_identifier; vocabulary metadata does not determine availability

external_duplicate_exclusion.normalization: Unicode NFKC then casefold, keep alphanumeric characters only; external normalized title identical to any internal title is excluded
